g1.label: 1 — a system called ___
g1.why: Apartheid was the South African system that separated people by race.

g2.label: 2 — the colour of their ___
g2.why: Apartheid divided people by the colour of their skin.

g3.label: 3 — he became a ___
g3.why: Mandela studied law, so he became a lawyer.

g4.label: 4 — sent him to ___ for life
g4.why: In 1964 the court sentenced him to life in prison.

g5.label: 5 — break stones in the hot ___
g5.why: The prisoners worked outdoors in the heat, so "the hot sun" fits.

g6.label: 6 — demanded his ___
g6.why: People around the world demanded that he be set free — his freedom.

g7.label: 7 — its first free ___
g7.why: In 1994 South Africa voted for the first time in a free election.

g8.label: 8 — every group had the same ___
g8.why: The Rainbow Nation idea is that every group has the same rights.

g1.label: 1 — a man ___ never gave up
g1.why: "A man" is a person, so use who.

g2.label: 2 — a system ___ separated people
g2.why: "A system" is a thing, so use which (or that).

g3.label: 3 — the place ___ he spent 18 years
g3.why: "The place" is a location, so use where.

g4.label: 4 — the year ___ the election was held
g4.why: "The year" is a time, so use when.

g5.label: 5 — families ___ homes had been destroyed
g5.why: The homes belong to the families, so you need the possessive whose.

g6.label: 6 — the party ___ he joined
g6.why: The ANC is a thing (a party), so use which.

g7.label: 7 — Cape Town, ___ lies in the south-west
g7.why: After a comma (non-defining clause) English uses which, never that.

g8.label: 8 — the journalist ___ interviewed Mandela
g8.why: "The journalist" is a person, so use who.

g1.label: 1 — not allowed to ___ in elections
g1.why: Under apartheid, black South Africans were not allowed to vote.

g2.label: 2 — he fought for ___
g2.why: Equality means everybody having the same rights — what Mandela fought for.

g3.label: 3 — a ___ outside a city
g3.why: A township is the poor area outside a city where black families had to live.

g4.label: 4 — finally ___ from prison
g4.why: To be released from prison means to be set free.

g5.label: 5 — eleven official ___
g5.why: South Africa has eleven official languages, among them English, Zulu and Afrikaans.

g6.label: 6 — a peaceful ___
g6.why: A protest is a public action against something people think is wrong.

g7.label: 7 — the Nobel ___ Prize
g7.why: Mandela and de Klerk received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1993.

g8.label: 8 — the ___ Nation
g8.why: South Africa is called the Rainbow Nation because of its many different groups.
